mapper.select: SELECT * FROM users WHERE BINARY username=BINARY #{name} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM people ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT role_key AS roleKey,label FROM roles ORDER BY role_key
SELECT role_key AS roleKey,person_id AS personId,name,title,role_value AS role,type,avatar,status FROM role_profiles ORDER BY role_key
SELECT token,user_id AS userId,role,created_at AS createdAt,expires_at AS expiresAt FROM sessions WHERE token=#{token}
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password=#{hash} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT purpose,phone,user_id AS userId,digest,sent_at AS sentAt,expires_at AS expiresAt,attempts FROM verification_codes WHERE purpose=#{purpose} AND phone=#{phone} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO verification_codes(purpose,phone,user_id,digest,sent_at,expires_at,attempts) VALUES(#{purpose},#{phone},#{userId},#{digest},#{sentAt},#{expiresAt},0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id=VALUES(user_id),digest=VALUES(digest),sent_at=VALUES(sent_at),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at),attempts=0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM verification_codes WHERE purpose=#{purpose} AND phone=#{phone}
mapper.update: UPDATE verification_codes SET attempts=attempts+1 WHERE purpose=#{purpose} AND phone=#{phone}
mapper.select: SELECT id,person_id AS personId,person_name AS personName,status,file_name AS fileName,image_url AS imageUrl,slot_key AS slot,label,updated_at AS updatedAt FROM faces ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,owner_id AS ownerId,owner_name AS ownerName,plate_no AS plateNo,status,last_access AS lastAccess FROM vehicles ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,title,content,target_role AS targetRole,read_flag AS `read`,created_at AS createdAt FROM messages ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id,time,actor,role,action,target,result FROM logs ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT * FROM people BINARY type=BINARY #{type}AND (INSTR(BINARY name,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY code,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY phone,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY college,BINARY #{keyword})>0 OR INSTR(BINARY department,BINARY #{keyword})>0) ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM people WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
